phases.decision: external inputs required before a specific operational slice can be selected
phases.later_output: On isolated non-business target: immutable source/image and resource readback, synthetic duplicate/header/protocol/default/tag/internal/alternate route tests, TCP versus HTTP checks, teardown/rollback record. No real tokens/financial data. This output is future evidence, not a prerequisite to planning its tests.

Qualified API origin transition separately from native OTA; same app/storage/signing identity, refresh/token and queued IDs/payloads preserved, in-flight uncertain writes reconciled, offline/reboot and rollback tested. Old API/OTA endpoints remain reachable until supported clients are accounted for.

Actual exclusive writer-route proof (or separately qualified authenticated origin), default/tag/internal/alternate bypass exclusion, coordinated raw-peer/logger/API/auth/OTA/Login implementation and immutable source/image provenance, required same-SHA gates and expanded security assessment. Trust removed before any bypass reopens.

Every supported and offline cohort/caller accounted for, API and native OTA across reboot plus compatible rollback demonstrated; no blind redirect/logout/reset. Final retirement only when old update and rollback channel no longer needed. Preserve ordered non-trusting-source-before-route rollback.

external_inputs.field: Non-business commissioning project/service boundary, responsible operator and exact source/artifact selection
external_inputs.request: Identify isolated project/region/service/resource names, non-business dependencies and no-live-secret boundary; nominate a frozen commissioning source/image with digest/build manifest. Accepted HEAD 0478648 is an available source baseline, not an approved deployment. Select it or a separately reviewed minimal fixture explicitly.
external_inputs.why: Current sole identified serving target is the business service; no safe non-business resource target is established. Known-different deployment cannot be replaced implicitly.

external_inputs.field: Exact test/canonical hostname, DNS control, operational ownership, cost ceiling and duration
external_inputs.responsible_role: Owner/budget authority and DNS/platform operator (names unavailable)
external_inputs.request: Supply approved FQDN(s), existing DNS provider/zone and who can authorize records/certificates; named routing/IAM/release owners; currency, maximum incremental monthly/test spend and test duration. No password, token or private key.
external_inputs.why: Historical provider preference and the USD estimate are not domain ownership or spending decisions.

external_inputs.field: Selected Compute route/reference/privilege export or narrowly arranged read access
external_inputs.responsible_role: Cloud project/organization routing and IAM administrator
external_inputs.request: Operator-provided selected JSON for forwarding rules -> target HTTPS proxies -> URL maps (including all header actions) -> backend services (headers/IAP/backends) -> regional/global NEGs (cloudRun service/tag/urlMask); only references to intended service and authorized project boundary. Include relevant backendServices.use/networkEndpointGroups.use, resource-update and inherited IAM grants/conditions, Run update/invoker/service-account impersonation control, Shared VPC/internal paths, domain/tag/default-URI controls. Include collection date, complete pagination and inaccessible scopes. Compute API was disabled; do not retry or enable here. Administrator arranges any required access/API action separately.
external_inputs.why: No safe inference that internal/alternate writer-bypass routes or privileged reference changes are excluded. Need applicable target controls to schedule a real isolated exercise, full effective closure before trust.

external_inputs.field: Supported installed terminal/web/proxy/platform caller register with coverage
external_inputs.responsible_role: Fleet/outlet operator and web/platform release owner
external_inputs.request: Sanitized existing register: pseudonymous terminal/cohort IDs, outlet binding class, app/package ID, native versionCode/name, signer SHA256, installed APK/build or digest where available, web bundle/version, API origin, native OTA URL/channel, source of measured flags, last observation, offline/unreported counts and supported caller endpoints. No bearer/refresh tokens, customer records or queue payloads. A count and version label alone cannot distinguish the two observed com.mandalika.pos version1/code1 artifacts.
external_inputs.why: No installation evidence exists in accessible inputs; neither empty fleet nor universal JS migration is justified.

external_inputs.field: Published OTA/native release and paired rollback ownership/records
external_inputs.request: Existing sanitized publication/export linking artifact digest, native signer/versionCode, compatibility bounds, OTA bundle ID/checksum/channel and publication date, retained rollback artifact and old-channel owner/lifetime. Latest retained GitHub release APK identified here; its download retention ends 2026-10-07. Exact known OTA bucket prefix is empty; identify other authorized locations/publication records if used. No live /ota/check, DB query or device operation requested here.
external_inputs.why: A signed artifact is available, but safe in-place upgrade/downgrade and queue/token/native updater persistence are not qualified. Empty object prefix does not prove no device bundle or no publication.

external_inputs.field: Real HTTP monitor/internal/proxy/asynchronous caller owners and intended test envelope
external_inputs.request: List supported application HTTP monitors and internal/external/platform callers, exact target origins, credential class only, contact role, and operational window/abort owner for later synthetic commissioning. Confirm retained TCP startup separately. IAP public-bearer compatibility is a conditional future test only if preferred route closure fails.
external_inputs.why: Avoid sacrificing supported callers or mistaking TCP startup for HTTP/financial-path availability.
